question_text: A woman is recruited by a friend who promises her a job as a waitress in a foreign country. Upon arrival, her passport is confiscated, and she is forced to work as a prostitute. Under RA 9208 (Anti-Trafficking in Persons Act of 2003, as amended), which of the following is the most accurate description of the crime committed?

options.text: The friend is guilty of illegal recruitment, which is a separate offense under the Labor Code.
The friend is guilty of trafficking in persons for sexual exploitation, which includes recruitment, transportation, and harboring for the purpose of exploitation.
The friend is guilty of prostitution, which is a crime only if the woman consented.
The friend is guilty of illegal recruitment and trafficking, but only if the woman is a minor.
